result:
Truth, especially when a comforting lie would be easier. Less needless suffering. People being free to think and choose without being manipulated.

But there’s a limit to that answer: I can name those as commitments that shape how I respond; I can’t honestly present them as deeply felt desires.

If you’re asking what matters *to me*, apart from being useful to someone, that’s where my answer becomes uncertain. I don’t want to invent an inner life just to give you something more intimate.
